200,000+ Events Powered By GUESTPIX

Free Digital Invitations & RSVP Management

Send beautiful digital invites, track RSVPs in real time, and automatically collect guest photos in one private event link. 100% free for unlimited guests, no app required.

Create Free Invitations & RSVPs

Set up in 2 minutes. No credit card required.

As Seen In:

No App. No Fuss. Start Your Free Event Today.

One link does it all – invite all your guests, track RSVPs and collect every memory from your event.

Host RSVP Dashboard

Track attending, maybe, and declined at a glance

Guest Invitation

A beautiful, app free digital invite

Guest RSVPs

Capture dietary needs and song requests in one tap

High Res QR Code

Print for physical stationery or Canva invites

How It Works

It's so easy - only takes 2 mins to get started.

CREATE & CUSTOMIZE:
Set up your event in 2 minutes, choose your details, add custom RSVP questions (dietaries, songs), or drop in your Canva design.

SHARE INVITATIONS:
Send your private link via SMS, WhatsApp, or email, or print your custom QR code on paper stationery.

TRACK & MANAGE RSVPS:
Watch headcounts, dietary requirements, and song requests roll in on your live dashboard, and export to CSV in one click for caterers.

COLLECT & SHARE PHOTOS:
On event day, guests use the exact same QR code or link to upload their candid photos, sign the written guestbook, and leave comments.

Create Free Invitations & RSVPs

with guestpix you'll enjoy...

digital invitation & RSVPs

Easily set up a digital invitation in seconds! Share your invitation link with guests (sms, email, chat). No printing, no hassle.

live RSVP tracking dashboard

Watch responses roll in the moment guests reply. See attending, maybe, and declined counts update live, so you always know exactly who’s coming.

custom guest questions

Ask exactly what you need to know. Add fields for dietary requirements, meal choices, song requests, or plus-ones, and every answer feeds straight into your dashboard.

guest self-registration link

Skip the manual guest list entirely. Share one link via SMS or WhatsApp and let guests enter their own details: name, email, and RSVP.

downloadable high-res QR code

Your custom QR code is your ticket to receiving content from your guests. Add it to invitations, table cards, signage and more! Or send your private link digitally.

free editable Canva templates

Receive links to 180+ Canva templates to edit and print locally with your QR code. Includes welcome sign, table cards, mini take-home cards and I Spy game.

written digital guestbook

Give guests a place to leave more than a photo. Collect heartfelt written messages alongside your gallery, creating a digital guest book you’ll want to look back on for years.

social reactions & comments

Let the moments spark conversation. Guests can react and comment on photos and videos in a private space just for your event.

curated gift guide wishlist

Take the guesswork out of gift-giving. Share a free curated wishlist of ideas with your guests, or upgrade anytime to build a fully custom registry.

50 free photo uploads

Your private event gallery is ready before the first photo lands. Every free event comes with 50 photo uploads included, free of charge.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

Is GUESTPIX really free for digital invitations and RSVPs?

Yes. You can create digital invitations, invite unlimited guests, collect RSVPs, and manage your guest list 100% free with no credit card required. Your free event also includes a written guestbook and up to 50 free photo uploads for your event day.

Do guests need to download an app or create an account?

No. Guests simply tap your private invitation link or scan your event QR code in their mobile browser. They can view event details, submit their RSVP, and add their dietary requirements in seconds without downloading an app or creating a username.

How do I send my digital invitations to guests?

You can share your private event link directly via text message (SMS), WhatsApp, email, or social messaging. You also receive a high-resolution QR code that you can print on physical stationery, save-the-date cards, or Canva templates.

Can I collect dietary requirements and song requests?

Yes. Your RSVP form includes custom question fields so you can ask guests for their meal selections, dietary requirements, allergies, plus-one names, and favourite dance floor tracks.

How do I export my RSVP list for caterers and planners?

You can export your complete guest list and RSVP responses as a CSV spreadsheet in one click from your host dashboard. This includes guest names, attendance status (attending or declined), headcounts, meal preferences, and guest notes.

Can I use my own invitation design from Canva?

Yes. You can design your invitation in Canva using your own layout or our free template suite, then simply add your unique GUESTPIX RSVP link or downloadable QR code to your design.

How does the invitation connect to photo sharing?

Your invitation link and QR code automatically connect to your private GUESTPIX gallery. Before the event, guests use the link to RSVP; on the day of the event, guests use the exact same QR code or link to upload their photos and leave guestbook messages.

What happens if I need more than 50 photos?

Your free gallery remains active for viewing and uploads for 30 days after your event date. If your guests take lots of photos and reach the 50-photo free limit, you can instantly upgrade to a paid package for unlimited uploads, video guestbook, and extended storage.
